why: A delivers the full cozy natural brief: two dark-wood bookcases fill the left wall, and the beige fabric armchair, white pleated lamp, jute rug and beige knit throw are warm and cohesive with the dark floor. B's tan leather armchair and swing-arm lamp are less cozy and less coherent, the cream throw is a weaker match, and it has only one bookcase for a wall the client wanted largely filled.
